import cache
import service

def test_make_key_distinction():
    # Test that different inputs produce different keys
    k1 = cache.make_key("text1", "profile1", "criteria1")
    k2 = cache.make_key("text1", "profile1", "criteria2")
    k3 = cache.make_key("text1", "profile2", "criteria1")
    k4 = cache.make_key("text2", "profile1", "criteria1")
    assert k1 != k2, "Different criteria should produce different keys"
    assert k1 != k3, "Different profile should produce different keys"
    assert k1 != k4, "Different text should produce different keys"

def test_make_key_consistency():
    # Test that same inputs produce same key
    k1 = cache.make_key("text1", "profile1", "criteria1")
    k2 = cache.make_key("text1", "profile1", "criteria1")
    assert k1 == k2, "Same inputs should produce same key"

def test_make_key_none_handling():
    # Test that None values are handled properly
    k1 = cache.make_key("text1", None, "criteria1")
    k2 = cache.make_key("text1", None, "criteria1")
    assert k1 == k2, "Same None values should produce same key"
    
    k3 = cache.make_key(None, "profile1", "criteria1")
    k4 = cache.make_key(None, "profile1", "criteria1")
    assert k3 == k4, "Same None values should produce same key"

def test_score_caching():
    # Test that score properly caches and recomputes when needed
    store = {}
    compute_call_count = [0]
    
    def compute():
        compute_call_count[0] += 1
        return 42
    
    # First call - should compute
    result1 = service.score(store, "text1", "profile1", "criteria1", compute)
    assert result1 == 42
    assert compute_call_count[0] == 1
    
    # Second call with same inputs - should reuse cache
    result2 = service.score(store, "text1", "profile1", "criteria1", compute)
    assert result2 == 42
    assert compute_call_count[0] == 1, "Cache should have reused, not recomputed"
    
    # Call with different text - should recompute
    result3 = service.score(store, "text2", "profile1", "criteria1", compute)
    assert result3 == 42
    assert compute_call_count[0] == 2, "Different text should trigger recomputation"
    
    # Call with different profile - should recompute
    result4 = service.score(store, "text1", "profile2", "criteria1", compute)
    assert result4 == 42
    assert compute_call_count[0] == 3, "Different profile should trigger recomputation"
    
    # Call with different criteria - should recompute
    result5 = service.score(store, "text1", "profile1", "criteria2", compute)
    assert result5 == 42
    assert compute_call_count[0] == 4, "Different criteria should trigger recomputation"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_make_key_distinction()
    print("test_make_key_distinction passed")
    test_make_key_consistency()
    print("test_make_key_consistency passed")
    test_make_key_none_handling()
    print("test_make_key_none_handling passed")
    test_score_caching()
    print("test_score_caching passed")
    print("All tests passed!")
